items: 【Spacious & Versatile Outdoor Aluminum Sofa Set】 This premium 4-piece patio furniture set includes a 3-seater, two lounge chairs, and a coffee table, all crafted from lightweight yet sturdy aluminum. This outdoor furniture set is perfect for large gatherings or intimate family moments in your backyard, poolside, or covered patio

【Luxury Upgrade, Extreme Comfort】 Experience cloud-like comfort with the Aoxun patio furniture. Featuring an industry-leading 5'' high-density seat cushion and soft backrest—20% thicker than other brands of patio conversation sets. Our fade-resistant Olefin fabric withstands sun exposure, moisture, and stains while maintaining its softness season after season

【Wider Seat, Reinforced Structure】 Our aluminum patio furniture set has a wider seat (26.7" depth) and slanted backrests with ergonomic design ensure superior comfort for extended relaxation. Reinforced structure, hurricane-grade steel frame and thickened support beams, maximum load-bearing capacity of 400LBS

【Stylish and Durable Premium Materials】 The patio sectional furniture set features recessed wooden armrests that are scratch-resistant; Patented reinforced U-shaped lower seat frame provides sturdy support for the widened seat and will not deform after long-term use; 3.5'' widened armrests double as drink holders; Rust-proof aluminum structure is weatherproof and durable for decades

【Multiple Uses】Provides a variety of layout options for various outdoor spaces, allowing you to spend leisure time with family and friends. This patio furniture set is versatile and suitable for backyards, gardens, terraces, balconies, poolside, etc

【Easy to Assemble and Maintain】Our outdoor patio set comes with detailed assembly instructions and part numbers for quick and easy installation. The removable cover has a smooth zipper for easy removal and machine washing

【24 Hours Online Customer Service】Backed by industry-leading support, you can feel confident investing in our quality outdoor furniture. Our patio furniture sets will be sent out in multiple boxes, please feel free to contact us if you have any questions about logistics, products and installation
